actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: capture_image

facts.text: The node class is RealSenseCameraNode and its constructor passes Node("RealSenseCameraNode", ...) to rclcpp::Node.
The node includes sensor_msgs/msg/image.hpp.
publishFrame assigns a sensor_msgs::msg::Image::SharedPtr from cv_bridge::CvImage(...).toImageMsg().
The constructor maps the color stream to RS2_FORMAT_RGB8 and the ROS encoding to sensor_msgs::image_encodings::RGB8.
getParameters reads enable_color with ENABLE_COLOR as its default.
ENABLE_COLOR is true.
setupPublishers creates the color image_transport publisher on the relative topic camera/color/image_raw inside the enable-color branch.
setupPublishers creates a sensor_msgs::msg::CameraInfo publisher on the relative topic camera/color/camera_info with queue depth 1.
publishFrame sets width, height, is_bigendian=false and step=width*bpp, stamps the header, then publishes CameraInfo and the image.
The README lists the Color image topic as /camera/color/image_raw with a sensor_msgs/msg/Image message link.
getParameters reads color_width and color_height with COLOR_WIDTH and COLOR_HEIGHT as defaults.
COLOR_WIDTH is 640 and COLOR_HEIGHT is 480; these are ROS parameter defaults, not device bounds.
updateStreamCalibData copies the intrinsic width and height and the configured optical frame id into CameraInfo.
The constructor maps the depth stream to sensor_msgs::image_encodings::TYPE_16UC1.
setupPublishers creates the depth image transporter on the relative topic camera/depth/image_rect_raw inside the enable-depth branch.
The constructor maps the infra1 stream and the infra2 stream to sensor_msgs::image_encodings::TYPE_8UC1.
setupPublishers creates the infra1 image transporter on the relative topic camera/infra1/image_rect_raw.
setupPublishers creates the aligned point-cloud publisher on the relative topic camera/aligned_depth_to_color/color/points when aligned point cloud and aligned depth are enabled.
The signalHandler function stops and closes every queried sensor and calls rclcpp::shutdown; it is a process signal handler body, not a ROS service.
The constructor registers signalHandler for SIGINT.
The README states that Intel ceased maintenance and no longer accepts patches for the project.
The README's known issues state that the node provides no dynamic reconfigure support for camera properties or presets.
